elements.label: Figure 5.10
elements.title: Line Chart of the S&P 500 Index Together with the Simple Moving Average of Length 3 (data source: adapted from S&P 500 [SPX] Historical Data)

details.trend: Both series show an overall increasing trend from 2013 to 2023, with the SMA smoothing the fluctuations of the SP 500 index.

elements: The chart shows the S&P 500 index values at the end of each year from 2013 to 2023 alongside the 3-period simple moving average (SMA), illustrating how the SMA smooths the original time series to highlight the trend-cycle component.
